what.text: This page follows refugees from Cameroon living in Chad, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7711 Cameroonian refugees in Chad, 5.5% of all refugees from Cameroon.
Nigeria hosts the most Cameroonian refugees, followed by Chad, the United States and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Ambazonia territory in Cameroon in every year from 2017 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Cameroon with JAS, and with the Islamic State group, in some years from 2015.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2001 at 15 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 42597, at the end of 2022.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2023, and the figure was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Chad.
These are year-end totals for Chad only, reported to UNHCR.
